overall.reasons: The change does what it should in part. In the L5 and L6 sun-15 frames the shadow pools are slightly darker and there is a soft contact darkening at the capsule foot and the mirror ball base, which moves toward UNREAL. The sunlit floor and sky are unchanged and nothing got brighter. However, AFTER adds visible new noise. In both AFTER runs a fine dither or crosshatch grain shows on the room's back and side walls (L5 and L6 sun 15 and sun 60 exterior). The second sphere is mottled and blotchy in the three sun-04 exterior frames. The capsule's shaded side, the box side and the sphere at left show crosshatch grain in the zoomed crops. BEFORE is smooth in all of these places, and the repeated pattern across both AFTER runs shows it is not capture noise. Criterion 4 is broken in many frames, so the round is a REGRESSION even though the pools moved partly toward UNREAL. The AFTER pools are still much lighter than UNREAL's near-black ones, so the result is CLOSE rather than a match.
